purpose: collect, understand and act on what customers tell us, so product decisions rest on evidence
entry_criteria: Feedback channels are identified (support, surveys, reviews, interviews)
An owner for feedback triage exists
A backlog or roadmap exists to receive insights
procedure: Gather feedback from every channel into one place with its source and customer segment.
Tag each item by theme and severity; merge duplicates and keep counts.
Separate what customers asked for from the problem they are trying to solve.
Compare themes with usage data to check that loud feedback matches real behavior.
Decide per theme: act, investigate, defer or decline, with a reason, and link to backlog items.
Tell customers what was decided where practical, and review the outcomes later.
deliverables: feedback log with themes and counts
acceptance_criteria: Every theme has a decision and a reason
Insights are checked against usage data
validation_method: Product owner review of the decisions.

validation.check: sample five feedback items and trace each to a theme and decision
compare the top theme with product usage data
validation.expect: data agrees or the disagreement is explained

failure_modes.mode: Only the loudest voice is heard

failure_modes.response: Link or decline with a reason

failure_modes.detection: Solutions recorded without the underlying problem

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: Forty tickets and two interviews mention slow report exports. Usage data confirms exports over a minute for large accounts. The theme is acted on and linked to a backlog item for background exports.
